description: Implementation of a Feishu Calendar service class with methods for creating, updating, deleting events, fetching calendars, and handling OAuth tokens, integrated with external APIs and internal utilities.

classes.name: FeishuCalendarService
classes.description: A class implementing the Calendar interface for interacting with Feishu calendar API, managing OAuth tokens, and calendar events.

methods.name: parseEventTime2Timestamp
methods.description: Converts an event time string to a Unix timestamp string.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event and handles attendees, returning the created event details.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event identified by UID.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event by UID.

methods.name: getAvailability
methods.description: Fetches free/busy times for specified calendars within a date range.

methods.name: listCalendars
methods.description: Lists available calendars, prioritizing primary calendars.

methods.name: translateEvent
methods.description: Converts internal CalendarServiceEvent to FeishuEvent format.

methods.name: translateAttendees
methods.description: Converts internal attendees to FeishuEventAttendee format.

methods.name: feishuAuth
methods.description: Returns an object with a getToken method for OAuth token retrieval.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.description: Refreshes OAuth access token using refresh token, updating credentials.

methods.name: fetcher
methods.description: Performs authenticated fetch requests to Feishu API endpoints.
